findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Hopefully, you have nurtured a relationship…”
findings.source_quote: “We recognized signs of conviction and lead them to brokenness and repentance and to receive salvation through faith in Christ.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kuvunjika moyo” with wording that conveys humble contrition, such as “unyenyekevu na toba,” so the sentence does not imply discouragement or heartbreak.
findings.translation_quote: “Tulitambua dalili za hatia ya dhambi na kuwaongoza kwenye kuvunjika moyo na toba, na kupokea wokovu kwa imani katika Kristo.”

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “It is important to worship in a church that you can support…”
findings.source_quote: “Many children have been lost to the faith because mom and dad were not supportive of the church where they were worshipping.”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise “wamepoteza imani” to convey that children have been lost from, or drawn away from, the faith—for example, “watoto wengi wamepotea kutoka katika imani.”
findings.translation_quote: “Watoto wengi wamepoteza imani kwa sababu mama na baba hawakuliunga mkono kanisa walimokuwa wakiabudu.”

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Our first responsibility in evangelization…”
findings.source_quote: “If we cannot evangelize our children, how can we expect to win others to the Lord?”
findings.suggested_fix: Use wording for sharing or bringing the gospel to the children, such as “Ikiwa hatuwezi kuwafikishia watoto wetu injili,” rather than wording that specifically means preaching to them.
findings.translation_quote: “Ikiwa hatuwezi kuwahubiria watoto wetu, tunawezaje kutarajia kuwaongoza wengine kwa Bwana?”
